title: Chapter 6197: Real Ghosts?

Chapter 6197: Real Ghosts?

Chapter 6197: Real Ghosts?

"Boom!" The radiant figure appeared holy and unstoppable. However, the tornado swept it back like a fallen statue. It coiled around and caught it, twisting it into nothingness.

It treated the supreme Buddha like a delicious candy and a total devourment didn't take long. Unfortunately, the tornado looked furious and finally initiated an attack.

"Careful!" The four shouted.

"Mobai Blade!" Orchidcore roared and unleashed a black-and-white slash. It turned into thousands of dragons, looking magnificent and grand.

"Paramount Taiji!" He utilized his clan's legacy. All the dragons coiled together to form the taiji symbol.

Yin birthed yang and yang birthed yin. The cycle of reinforcement and counteractions summoned a sword momentum around the group.

"So this is Mobai Blade, it lives up to its reputation." Li Xian couldn't help but praise.

He recalled the power of Progenitor Mobai's sword dao, bringing the Mu back to prominence. Now, they still relied on it long after his death.

His clan was superior to the Mu but they had nothing left outside of Radiance Mantra. Unfortunately, this was an entry art, hence their decline.

The mighty sword barrier couldn't stand a chance against the furious tornado taking the form of a palm.

"Go!" Mu Hu roared and turned into a gigantic tiger, meeting the palm strike with its ferocious paw.

"Bam!" Mu Hu lost the exchange instantly and the tornado swept them against the ground.

Their vitality churned and they vomited blood.

"Are you okay?!' Li Xian rushed outside and helped them out while Li Qiye only watched with a smile.

The tornado suddenly dispersed and didn't harm them any longer.

"What is going on?" Orchidcore became confused.

The tornado could have killed them easily but disappeared without warning. The Li's residence became as peaceful as ever.

Li Xian smiled wryly and said: "It is most likely our ancestors messing around, nothing more."

The four exchanged glances, not buying this explanation.

"Ghosts are real?" Princess Chen murmured.

"Well, Fellow Daoists, let's rest first and we can talk later." Li Xian suggested.

The four realized the difficulty of the task and agreed, choosing to recuperate first.

On the second day, they were good as news except for their confidence.

"What should we do?" Orchidcore asked for everyone's opinion.

"We don't stand a chance." Princess Chen shook her head."

"They're strange but there is no malice." Monk Zhu said.

"Then why are they causing such a big commotion? There must be a reason why these so-called ghosts are doing it." Orchidcore said.

"I agree." The monk nodded.

"Our adventure starts with failure?" Mu Hu scratched his head and said: "What are we going to tell the teachers?"

"..." The others were left speechless.

"Well, it is true we can't come back with a loss, it's embarrassing if others find out." Monk Zhu said.

The four were famous and powerful after joining. Their adventure this time was to seek a great fortune. To come back so early would be humiliating.

"But what else can we do but to accept defeat?" Princess Chen smiled wryly.

"Maybe ask a teacher to come." Orchidcore said: "To see what is going on."

"Ah, no need for that, the seniors of the academy are surely busy with important matters. We don't need to waste their time." Li Xian said.

The teachers were prestigious cultivators; some were emperors.

Li Xian didn't wish everyone to know about the strange matters going on in his residence. After all, his goal was to have an ordinary life.

Emperors coming might result in a devastating battle - the end of their residence and potentially their lives.
